source_summary.quality_note: 案例均来自已抓取的应急管理部 PDF；自动抽取的数值和流程标签需在正式引用前人工复核。

warning_lead_minutes.description: Time between first actionable warning and danger arrival.

evacuation_order_delay_minutes.description: Delay from warning release to explicit evacuation/transfer order.

response_activation_delay_minutes.description: Delay from risk detection to graded response activation.

communication_failure_rate.description: Share of target population missed or delayed by channel degradation.

grassroots_call_strength.description: Intensity of grid/community confirmation and call-to-response work.

vulnerable_priority_weight.description: Priority weight applied to older, disabled, institutional or digitally excluded people.

bridge_closure_threshold.description: Risk score at which bridge/culvert closure or reroute is triggered.

route_failure_probability.description: Probability that an assigned transfer route becomes blocked or requires rerouting.

shelter_capacity_pressure.description: Expected pressure on formal shelter capacity.

public_trust_delta_prior.description: Prior change in trust/satisfaction caused by warning credibility and transfer burden.

casualty_rate_anchor.description: Outcome anchor derived from reported casualties when exposed population is unknown.

property_loss_rate_anchor.description: Outcome anchor derived from reported direct economic loss.

source_labels.CASE_DERIVED: Extracted or inferred from MEM case reports.
source_labels.QGIS_DERIVED: Requires QGIS spatial package or route/risk overlay for final value.
source_labels.SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION: Temporary assumption used only when no case evidence exists.
